name: udigity-management-system
description: Udigity Internal Management System (HR, CRM, Outreach & Delivery)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
